name: Lalakhali
summary: A river with strikingly blue-green water, tea gardens on its banks and boat rides, a short day trip from Sylhet city.
season_note: Water is clearest and bluest in winter and post-monsoon. Heavy monsoon makes it muddy and rides can be limited.

reach.how: Bus Dhaka to Sylhet, then CNG or hired car to Lalakhal (about 1 hr)
reach.note: Make Lalakhal a day trip from Sylhet.

local.mode: Private car or CNG from Sylhet

attractions.name: Lalakhal boat ride
attractions.what: Paddle or motor boat along the blue-green river between tea-covered hills.
attractions.tip: Agree boat fare and duration before boarding.

attractions.name: Lalakhal tea garden
attractions.what: Tea slopes that come right down to the river, good for photos.
attractions.tip: Do not pluck leaves; ask before entering working areas.

attractions.name: Riverbank walk
attractions.what: A calm walk on the bank watching boats and kids swim.
attractions.tip: Rocks and mud can be slippery.

attractions.name: River sunset
attractions.what: Golden light on the water as the day trippers leave.
attractions.tip: Stay till late afternoon for fewer crowds.

attractions.name: Roadside snack stalls
attractions.what: Small stalls selling tea, jhalmuri and fried snacks.

budget.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

mid.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

luxury.area: No stay at the site; use the nearby town

rules: Wear a life jacket if offered.
